name: Exists.intro
typeText: ∀ {α : Sort u} {p : α → Prop} (w : α), p w → Exists.{u} p

/-- Existential introduction. If `a : α` and `h : p a`,
  then `⟨a, h⟩` is a proof that `∃ x : α, p x`. -/
  | intro (w : α) (h : p w) : Exists p
